notes.title: Bus Bound - Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
🚍 Schedule update:

📢 Bus Bound will arrive in 2026! 🗓🚏

Master the flow of traffic in a dense city environment and build trust with your passengers by safely navigating various on-road obstacles. 🚌⬆️👍

Unlock new routes and American buses as your actions shape and improve the world around you! 💪

[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/TyqB0gge0rU"][/dynamiclink]
Key Features[p align="justify"]A City Full of Life: Explore Emberville, a fully simulated, densely inhabited town that comes to life with a dynamic traffic system, day/night cycle, and distinct weather conditions. From bustling intersections to quiet neighborhoods, every area has its own rhythm, and your route will help shape its future.
[p align="justify"]Drive American Icons: Take the wheel of true-to-life buses from top American manufacturers, including the New Flyer Xcelsior 40ft CNG and the Blue Bird Sigma. With a growing lineup of over a dozen vehicles at launch, you’ll always have the right bus for the job.
[p align="justify"]Shape the City: You’re not just driving, you’re improving public life! Upgrade stops, unlock new routes, earn passive perks, and see each district evolve into a more vibrant, pedestrian-friendly space thanks to your bus-driving efforts.
[p align="justify"]Multiplayer on the Move: Band together with up to three other players in online co-op! Split off to tackle multiple routes simultaneously and contribute to your host’s goal to improve Emberville.
[p align="justify"]Customize Your Fleet: With each shift, you’ll generate goodwill with your riders to unlock new buses, visual styles and upgrades. Whether you prefer a relaxing driving experience or want to master and optimize every detail of your run, the freedom to make each trip your own is yours.

notes.title: Bus Bound - Announcement
notes.content:
Calling all bus drivers! 🚍

Embark on a journey to Emberville with Bus Bound, the latest title from the creators of Bus Simulator 21 and Bus Simulator 18, offering a unique and meaningful take on American Bus Transportation. 🚌

As you become the citizens' bus hero, you will witness the city evolve before your eyes from the positive impact of your actions, one stop at a time. 🚏

Explore and improve a vibrant city with a fleet of authentic vehicles while trying to maintain a good reputation with your passengers. 👍

[previewyoutube="VUjGCh9WTts;full"][/previewyoutube]
Key Features
A City Full of Life: Explore Emberville, a fully simulated, densely inhabited town that comes to life with a dynamic traffic system and distinct day/night and weather conditions. From bustling intersections to quiet neighborhoods, every area has its own rhythm, and your route will help shape its future.

Drive American Icons: Take the wheel of true-to-life buses from top American manufacturers, including the New Flyer Xcelsior 40ft CNG and the Blue Bird Sigma. With a growing lineup of over a dozen vehicles at launch, you’ll always have the right bus for the job.

Shape the City: You’re not just driving, you’re improving public life! Upgrade stops, unlock new routes, earn passive perks, and see each district evolve into a more vibrant, pedestrian-friendly space.

Multiplayer on the Move: Band together with up to three other players in online co-op! Split off to tackle multiple routes simultaneously and contribute to your host’s goal to improve Emberville.

Customize Your Fleet: With each shift, you’ll generate goodwill with your riders to unlock new buses, visual styles and upgrades. Whether you prefer a relaxing driving experience or want to master and optimize every detail of your run, the freedom to make each trip your own is yours.


Coming soon to Steam! ⏱️🚏 Wishlist now! ✅
